entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
Hon'Ble Ms. Justice B.S.Bhanumathi
 Criminal Petition No.8758 Of 2023
Order:

This Criminal Petition is filed under Section 482 Cr.P.C aggrieved by the return endorsement dated 13.10.2023, passed by the XI Additional District Judge-cum-Special Judge for cases under the SC &
ST (PoA) Act at Vishakapatnam, in a petition filed under Section 438 Cr.P.C in connection with Crime No.311 of 2013 of Pendurthi Police Station.

2. The petitioner who is accused in the above cited crime filed a petition under Section 438 Cr.P.C to grant anticipatory bail in the crime registered for the offences punishable under Sections 376, 420 IPC, 3(1)(r), 3 (1)(s), 3(2)(va) of the SC & ST (PoA) Act and the trial Court returned the petition with the following objection:-
"How this petition maintainable under Section 18(a) of SC & ST Act can be explained.
3. Before filing the same, the petitioner approached this Court vide Crl.P.No.7441 of 2023 seeking anticipatory bail in the same case.
But this Court without going into merits of the case, dismissed the petition directing the petitioner to approach the concerned Sessions Court seeking anticipatory bail.

4. The learned counsel for the petitioner submitted that the office of the Court cannot raise objection on legality of a petition at the time of its registration and placed reliance on the decision of Hon'ble Contd...
Supreme Court in P.Surendran Vs. State by Inspector of Police in SLP (CRL.) No.1832 of 2019,
dated 29.03.2019, wherein it was held that the High Court Registry could not have exercised its judicial power to answer the maintainability of the petition, when the same was in the realm of the Court.

entities.text: P.Surendran Vs. State by Inspector of Police in SLP (CRL.) No.1832 of 2019
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 5. In view of the same, the trial Court ought to have registered the petition and decided the said question while disposing of the petition.

6. Accordingly, the criminal petition is allowed by setting aside the objection raised by the trial Court on 13.10.2023 and the trial Court is directed to register the petition and dispose of the same on merits after hearing both sides including the question of maintainability of the petition.
Pending miscellaneous applications, if any, shall stand closed.
